description.narrative: (Liberia): USAID Youth Advance is a cross-sectoral activity that addresses the needs of out-of-school youth, includes positive youth development principles, and supports the overarching economic growth priorities of both USAID and the Government of Liberia. The activity's objective is to enable out-of-school youth to become productive citizens and improve their opportunities for employability or entrepreneurship. The activity will support market-driven, locally relevant educational and training opportunities to prepare young people for a better future and build their self-confidence. The activity will also strengthen the capacity of institutions offering technical training to create opportunities for youth to secure sustainable incomes..With FY 2022 funds, this activity will provide youth between the ages of 15-35 with work readiness, literacy, numeracy, technical training, social, and leadership development skills. USAID Youth Advance seeks to create stronger, more resilient communities where youth take a more active role in the decisions that will affect their lives. This activity will also provide access and messaging to increase awareness of family planning services and promote youth-friendly services. Additionally, the activity will provide grants to Youth Serving Local Organizations to strengthen their capacity to serve more youth in the targeted communities. This activity supports the U.S. government's goal to increase high-quality and equitable education and opportunities for children and youth and the Administration's priority of growing economic opportunities and prosperity for communities globally. It will also contribute to mitigating the secondary effects of COVID-19.
